art_direction: 31岁男性站在书店窗前，深绿外套与雨滴玻璃，暖室内灯勾出轮廓。
composition: one original focal subject, centered and readable within a circular avatar crop
creative_direction: Photograph an original 31-year-old man standing by the rain-streaked window of a small bookshop. Frame him from the chest upward in a dark green canvas jacket over a charcoal sweater. His short textured hair and calm slightly amused expression remain the focal point. Warm interior light brushes one cheek while cool rainy daylight shapes the other. Behind him, suggest book spines as soft unlettered color blocks, with no readable titles. Include realistic fabric stitching, fine raindrops, and subtle glass reflections without obscuring the face. Create a square 1024x1024 avatar with a clear central silhouette that remains legible at thumbnail size. Use an original text-only composition, without lettering, logos, signatures, or watermarks.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
